notes: The ASV reorders object and complement in both halves; the units are matched by syntactic role rather than by proximity, so the complement English goes to the second λαόν μου and the second ἠγαπημένην, with rule 15 permitting the discontinuity.
τόν precedes its noun and so takes the supplied determiner *that* together with the relativizer *which* under rule 31, the predicate noun keeping the supplied copula under rules 53 and 92.
The ASV writes *also* for the particle, so ὡς keeps only the bare *As* under rule 82.
